title: Medical Cannabis in New Jersey: How the State Program Works
seoTitle: Medical Cannabis in New Jersey: How the State Program Works | LADY L CANNABIS
description: A plain overview of New Jersey's Medicinal Cannabis Program: registering, caregivers and ATCs, with official links. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary.
lede: New Jersey runs a separate program for registered medical patients, with its own registration, ID cards and caregivers. Here is a plain-language overview with official links. One thing up front: Lady L Cannabis is an adult-use dispensary.

blocks.html: From Lady L's FAQ: “No medical card is required. Lady L Cannabis operates as an adult-use dispensary, so any customer 21 or older can walk in and make a purchase.”
This page explains the state's medical program for anyone who wants to understand it. It is general information about New Jersey, not a description of anything Lady L offers.

The state decides which diagnoses qualify and publishes the current list on its Medicinal Cannabis Program page. Whether the program fits you is a conversation for you and a registered healthcare practitioner.
